claims: Harry Styles released his fourth studio album "Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." on March 6, 2026.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." marks Harry Styles' return after a two-year break.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." is a 12-track album.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." is a dance-pop/alternative album.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." is heavily influenced by disco.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." focuses on themes of burnout, fame, and rejuvenation.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." is available on major streaming platforms.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." has a dance-pop, electronic, and alternative pop sound.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." serves as a departure from Harry Styles' previous pop-rock work.
The 12-track album "Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." includes songs "Aperture", "American Girls", "Ready, Steady, Go!", and "Dance No More".
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." was produced in collaboration with Kid Harpoon.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." is inspired by Harry Styles' desire to experience music from the audience's perspective after his long 2023 tour.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." achieved the biggest opening week for a male solo artist in nine years in the UK.
"Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally." follows Harry Styles' 2022 album "Harry's House".
